raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Lets the Mamba2 mixer run inside the piecewise CUDA graphs of prefill and mixed prefill+decode
steps, instead of eagerly between graph pieces. It is opt-in: leave `vllm::mamba_mixer2` out of
`compilation_config.splitting_ops`. This PR is part of a series that brings piecewise CUDA graphs to
Mamba2 prefill steps, and it is stacked on #61501 and #61497. Tested with #61293 applied, but it
does not depend on it. Like #61501, it needs flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6100 (`cu_seqlens` in
`SSDCombined`), which is merged into FlashInfer main but not yet in a release.

## Claims

- Up to 1.30x output throughput (OTPS/gpu) over `main` + #61293 with the whole series, on 1x B200
  with Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-NVFP4-W4A4 and MTP=2 (up to 1.14x without this PR). On its own, this
  PR is 1.08-1.14x over #61501 at concurrency 8-32, 1.05-1.06x at 2-4 and 64, and flat at 1 and
  128.
- At concurrency 16, a mixed prefill+decode step takes 10.3 ms instead of 24.9 ms (nsys, vs
  #61501): 7 graph launches and 105 eager kernels instead of 30 and 336, and 5.9 ms of host time
  instead of 22.4 ms.
- p90 inter-chunk latency at concurrency 16-32 drops from 21-22 ms to 11-12 ms (vs #61501).

## Validation

End-to-end serving throughput:

- **Base:** `main` + #61293.
- **+ #61497 + #61501:** Base plus both PRs, with `--mamba-prefill-backend flashinfer`.
- **+ this PR:** the same, plus this PR, with `vllm::mamba_mixer2` left out of `splitting_ops`.
- **Hardware:** 1x B200, TP1.
- **FlashInfer:** upstream main at `2a2cceab0`, which includes flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6100 and
  flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6206.
- **Workload:** SPEED-Bench `throughput_1k`, `low_entropy` category (512 prompts),
  `max_tokens` 200, served through aiperf.
  - Warm-up: 256 requests at concurrency 128, discarded.
  - Then the full 512-prompt dataset at each concurrency from 128 down to 1.
  - Concurrency 64 and 128 were run 2 more times; those rows are the mean of 3 runs. The #61501
    column at concurrency 1-4 is the mean of 4 runs.

Values are OTPS/gpu (output tokens/s per GPU); both speedups are over Base:

| Concurrency | Base | + #61497 + #61501 | + this PR | Speedup through #61501 | Speedup with this PR |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 760 | 822 | 822 | 1.08x | 1.08x |
| 2 | 1250 | 1364 | 1433 | 1.09x | 1.15x |
| 4 | 1890 | 2106 | 2209 | 1.11x | 1.17x |
| 8 | 2896 | 3313 | 3639 | 1.14x | 1.26x |
| 16 | 4398 | 4999 | 5681 | 1.14x | 1.29x |
| 32 | 7045 | 7979 | 9159 | 1.13x | 1.30x |
| 64 | 11506 | 12751 | 13640 | 1.11x | 1.19x |
| 128 | 16641 | 18167 | 18135 | 1.09x | 1.09x |

Mid concurrencies have the most prefill and mixed-batch interruptions, so they gain the most; the
effect is smaller at low and high concurrency.

Accuracy: GPQA-diamond through NeMo Gym on 1x GB300, TP1, MTP=2 (198 questions x 8 repeats, thinking on,
temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95), with the serve command below plus `--max-model-len 262144
--reasoning-parser nemotron_v3`. pass@1, mean over the 8 repeats ± standard error:

- No prefix reuse (as below): 75.69 ± 0.68%
- Prefix reuse (`--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align`, no ReplaySSM; the mixer runs eagerly here, since capturing it needs `--mamba-cache-mode none`): 76.52 ± 0.65%

<details>
<summary>Serve and client commands</summary>

`--mamba-prefill-backend flashinfer` selects #61501's scan for prefills, and `splitting_ops`
without `vllm::mamba_mixer2` captures the mixer in the piecewise graphs. The #61501 column used the
same command without `splitting_ops`; Base also dropped `--mamba-prefill-backend`.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
MODEL=${MODEL:?path or HF id of the Nemotron-3.5-Lightning NVFP4 W4A4 checkpoint}
NUMA_NODE=${NUMA_NODE:?NUMA node local to the GPU}
CAPTURE_SIZES='[1,2,4,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64,72,80,88,96,104,112,120,128,136,144,152,160,168,176,184,192,200,208,216,224,232,240,248,256,272,288,304,320,336,352,368,384,400,416,432,448,464,480,496,512,528,544,560,576,592,608,624,640,656,672,688,704,720,736,752,768,784,800,816,832,848,864,880,896,912,928,944,960,976,992,1008,1024,1152,1280,1408,1536,1664,1792,1920,2048,2560,3072,3584,4096,5120,6144,7168,8192,10240,12288,14336,16384,18432,20480,22528,24576,26624,28672,30720,32768]'
# vLLM's default splitting ops without vllm::mamba_mixer2.
SPLITTING_OPS='["vllm::unified_attention_with_output","vllm::unified_mla_attention_with_output","vllm::mamba_mixer","vllm::short_conv","vllm::qwen4_exp_ple_short_conv","vllm::qwen4_exp_qsa_with_output","vllm::linear_attention","vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core","vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_packed","vllm::gdn_attention_core_xpu","vllm::olmo_hybrid_gdn_full_forward","vllm::sparse_attn_indexer","vllm::rocm_aiter_sparse_attn_indexer","vllm::deepseek_v4_attention","vllm::hpc_rope_norm_forward","vllm::unified_kv_cache_update","vllm::unified_mla_kv_cache_update"]'

vllm serve "$MODEL" \
  --served-model-name nemotron-3.5-lightning \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --max-num-seqs 128 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --async-scheduling \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2,"moe_backend":"flashinfer_trtllm"}' \
  --mamba-cache-mode none \
  --mamba-backend flashinfer \
  --mamba-prefill-backend flashinfer \
  --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16 \
  --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding \
  --mamba-cache-philox-rounds 5 \
  --use-replayssm \
  --compilation-config "{\"mode\":3,\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE\",\"max_cudagraph_capture_size\":32768,\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\":${CAPTURE_SIZES},\"splitting_ops\":${SPLITTING_OPS}}" \
  --numa-bind --numa-bind-nodes "$NUMA_NODE" \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
```

Client, run once per concurrency level:

```bash
aiperf profile \
  --model nemotron-3.5-lightning --tokenizer "$MODEL" --tokenizer-trust-remote-code \
  --endpoint-type chat --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --streaming --use-legacy-max-tokens \
  --url http://localhost:8001 \
  --input-file "$SPEED_BENCH_1K_LOW_ENTROPY_JSONL" \
  --extra-inputs max_tokens:200 --extra-inputs skip_special_tokens:false \
  --random-seed 1234 --use-server-token-count \
  --concurrency "$CONC" --request-count 512 --num-dataset-entries 512
```

</details>

## Details

`vllm::mamba_mixer2` is a piecewise splitting op, so in every prefill or mixed step each Mamba2
layer runs eagerly between graph pieces. That work is host-bound: a decode request that shares a
step with a ~1k-token prefill waits 20-30 ms instead of ~3 ms. #61497 and #61501 trim the host
overhead; this PR captures the mixer.

Changes:

- Opt-in with no new flag: leave `vllm::mamba_mixer2` out of `splitting_ops`. Requires the V2 model
  runner, FlashInfer ReplaySSM decodes, `--mamba-prefill-backend flashinfer` and
  `--mamba-cache-mode none`, checked at startup.
- Captured steps run `conv_ssm_forward_static()`, whose shapes depend only on the padded token
  count. `Mamba2AttentionMetadataBuilder` writes its per-step metadata into persistent buffers with
  one upload, on piecewise steps only.
- Prefill: `causal_conv1d_fn` and `mamba_chunk_scan_flashinfer_static`. Decode rows and padding up
  to the next 128-token boundary are identity rows (zeroed inputs, dt = -1e4); later padding is
  skipped. Steps with more prefills than the scan's slots (about one per 512 tokens, at least 8)
  run eagerly.
- Decode: the varlen conv1d update and FlashInfer ReplaySSM over the padded decode rows.
- Steps above the largest capture size, FULL decode graphs and eager steps keep the existing path.
  A static Triton scan is a separate change.

+FLASHINFER_SSD_STATE_SIZE = 128

+def get_ssd_runner(
+    device_index: int,
+    stream_id: int,
+    nheads: int,
+    ngroups: int,
+    state_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    has_initial_states: bool,
+):
+    # Runner workspaces are mutable, so like flashinfer.mamba.ssd_combined_fwd
+    # keep one runner per stream.
+    from flashinfer.mamba import SSDCombined
+
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return SSDCombined(
+            chunk_size=128,
+            nheads=nheads,
+            headdim=FLASHINFER_SSD_HEAD_DIM,
+            dstate=FLASHINFER_SSD_STATE_SIZE,
+            ngroups=ngroups,
+            io_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            state_dtype=state_dtype,
+            has_d=True,
+            d_has_hdim=False,
+            has_initial_states=has_initial_states,
+            has_varlen=True,
+            has_z=False,
+            backend="cake",
+        )
+
+
+def mamba_chunk_scan_flashinfer(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    dt: torch.Tensor,
+    A: torch.Tensor,
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    C: torch.Tensor,
+    D: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    ssm_state: torch.Tensor,
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    has_initial_states: torch.Tensor | None,
+) -> None:
+    """Scan the prefill tokens and write each sequence's final state.
+
+    x: (seqlen, nheads, headdim) bf16, may be a strided view
+    dt: (seqlen, nheads)
+    A, dt_bias: (nheads,) fp32
+    B, C: (seqlen, ngroups, dstate) bf16, may be strided views
+    D: (nheads,) bf16
+    cu_seqlens: (batch + 1,) int32, starting at 0
+    out: (seqlen, nheads, headdim) bf16, contiguous; written in place
+    ssm_state: (num_slots, nheads, headdim, dstate) state cache
+    state_indices: (batch,) cache slot of each sequence
+    has_initial_states: (batch,) bool, or None when no sequence has a state
+    """
+    initial_states = (
+        gather_initial_states(ssm_state, state_indices, has_initial_states)
+        if has_initial_states is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    runner = get_ssd_runner(
+        x.device.index,
+        torch.accelerator.current_stream(x.device).stream_id,
+        x.size(1),
+        B.size(1),
+        ssm_state.dtype,
+        initial_states is not None,
+    )
+    _, final_states = runner.run(
+        x.unsqueeze(0),
+        dt.unsqueeze(0),
+        A,
+        B.unsqueeze(0),
+        C.unsqueeze(0),
+        D=D,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias,
+        dt_softplus=True,
+        initial_states=initial_states,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,

+# prefill sequences, so any value is correct.

+# padding) get this dt. FlashInfer's SSD preprocess

+# compute softplus(x) as log(1 + exp(x)) for x <= 20, and exp underflows to 0
+# in float32 below about -88, so softplus(dt + dt_bias) is exactly 0: with x, B
+# and C zeroed these rows leave their sequence's state unchanged and output 0.
+# This needs dt_limit[0] == 0; the mixer always passes (0, inf).

+            nheads=nheads,
+            headdim=FLASHINFER_SSD_HEAD_DIM,
+            dstate=FLASHINFER_SSD_STATE_SIZE,
+            ngroups=ngroups,
+            io_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            state_dtype=state_dtype,
+            has_d=True,
+            d_has_hdim=False,
+            has_initial_states=True,
+            has_varlen=True,
+            has_z=False,

+def _prepare_static_scan_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    b_ptr,
+    c_ptr,
+    dt_ptr,
+    dt_out_ptr,
+    prefill_bounds_ptr,
+    stride_x,
+    stride_b,
+    stride_c,
+    stride_dt,
+    num_tokens,
+    x_size: tl.constexpr,
+    bc_size: tl.constexpr,
+    nheads: tl.constexpr,
+    X_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    BC_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,

+    bc_offsets = tl.arange(0, BC_BLOCK)
